name: Multi Hanna Kreasindo Tbk.
summary: PT Multi Hanna Kreasindo Tbk. is an Indonesian company specializing in industrial waste management. The firm provides a comprehensive suite of services, encompassing the collection, transportation, and responsible utilization of various waste streams, alongside specialized treatment options for liquid, medical, and solid waste materials. Founded in 2004, its headquarters are situated in Bekasi, Indonesia. The company operates as a subsidiary of PT Multi Hanna Sinergitama.
